description: Report this server's own release version and which Bible data it has loaded, including each edition's licence, required attribution and how many verses it may quote verbatim per call. Use when asked which version runs, when collecting facts for a bug report, and before planning a longer quotation. Returns no scripture — use bible_lookup for verse text.
name: bible_server_info

daten_stand.description: Date of the most recent source download, not a deployment date.

verse_max.description: Maximum verses this edition may be quoted verbatim in one call; null means no such limit.

voreinstellung.description: Translation code used when a call omits `translation`.

strong_lexikon_sprache.description: Language of the lexicon entries, present only if a lexicon is loaded.
